name: Dukhan Bank Q.P.S.C.
summary: Dukhan Bank Q.P.S.C. provides various banking and financial products and services to personal, private, and corporate clients. The company operates in four segments: Wholesale Banking; Retail and Private Banking; Treasury and Investments Division; and Subsidiaries. It offers current, savings, and time deposit accounts; debit, credit, and prepaid cards; personal, vehicle, and home financing; salary advance; and wealth management solutions.
